task.title: Harden RW-01 research ticket truth source
task.summary_zh: 把已 live 的 RW-01 research ticket 路徑從 local fallback 推進到 service-owned truth，減少 snapshot 依賴。
acceptance: RW-01 不再主要依賴 local fallback
Read path 有明確 truth source
task.next: Owner finalized approved RW-01 truth hardening. Service-backed research ticket read/write path is the primary truth source when configured, with reviewer-approved regression coverage and passing RW-01/RW-02 checks.
review_notes_zh: 審查通過：（1）read path 正確：list_research_tickets 透過 _read_dataset_records 優先讀取 service store，fallback 到 local snapshot；get_research_ticket 透過 _service.record 優先讀取，unavailable 才 fallback；（2）write path 正確：create_research_ticket 與 patch_research_ticket 在 PANTHEON_BFF_RESEARCH_TICKET_STORE 設定時透過 write_records 持久化至 service store，否則 _save() 到 local fallback；（3）regression coverage 完整：新增 test_rw01_service_backed_reads_override_seeded_snapshot 與 test_rw01_create_and_patch_persist_to_service_store 兩個 service-backed 測試；（4）全部 6 個 RW-01 測試通過，RW-02 regression 4/4 通過，無新增失敗。

handoffs.message: RW-01 now reads service-backed research ticket truth before local fallback, persists create/patch to PANTHEON_BFF_RESEARCH_TICKET_STORE when configured, and adds regression coverage for service-backed read/write.

Review approved: service-backed read path (list + detail) reads service store first with local fallback, write path persists to service store when PANTHEON_BFF_RESEARCH_TICKET_STORE is configured. All 6 RW-01 tests pass, RW-02 regressions 4/4 pass.
